design_voxcpm2_voice: design speech with VoxCPM2 voice design command using text and optional control instruction
clone_voice_with_reference: clone a voice using reference audio and generate speech from provided text
batch_generate_speech: batch-generate speech files from a text input file with one text per line
load_voxcpm_model: load a VoxCPM model from local path or Hugging Face Hub with optional LoRA weights
detect_model_architecture: detect the VoxCPM model architecture from a local config or Hugging Face model id
